scripts.title: Scripts

contracts.clean: clean(raw, ctx) receives the flattened tables and returns the cleaned ones. Without it, the flattened tables are the clean data.
contracts.output: prepare_output(cleaned, ctx) returns the tables for the clean-data dashboard. Optional.
contracts.indicator: compute(cleaned, ctx) returns one table for this indicator: the columns it is broken down by and at least one numeric column, such as value. The table is published under the indicator’s name.

scripts.templateReplaceMessage: The editor has unsaved changes and the template replaces them. Ctrl+Z brings them back.

reference.title: Reference

returns.clean: Return a dictionary of table names to DataFrames. Table names use lowercase letters, digits and underscores. Without script 1, the flattened tables are the clean data.
returns.output: Return a dictionary of table names to DataFrames: the tables the clean data dashboard shows. Without script 2, it shows the clean tables.
returns.indicator: Return one DataFrame: the columns to break the figure down by (dimensions) and at least one numeric column. By convention value is what a widget plots by default, and numerator and denominator let it plot a rate as a ratio of sums.

parameters.clean: raw: a dictionary of the flattened tables, "main" and one per repeat group. Select answers are choice labels.
parameters.output: cleaned: a dictionary of the tables script 1 returned (or the flattened tables).
parameters.indicator: cleaned: a dictionary of the tables script 1 returned (or the flattened tables).

reference.cellsText: A line that starts with # %% begins a cell. Run cell tests the script from the start and stops at the end of that cell, without validating the output. ctx.show(data, name) adds a preview of a DataFrame, Series or value to the result of a test; in a run it does nothing.

form.description: The form dictionary: questions, choices and the labels of the current form.

log.description: A Python logger. Its messages appear in the step's log.

reference.description: The project's reference tables by name, as DataFrames.

show.description: Shows a DataFrame, Series or any value in the result of a sample test, as it is at this call, and returns it unchanged. In a run it does nothing.

name.description: The code a label stands for, by question name or path. It also searches earlier form versions. None when unknown or ambiguous.

column_label.description: The question label of a column of the flattened tables, or None.
